title: SOV Schematic Definition
description: Documentation only: validation is the hand-written checkDefinition in src/07-state-space.js. A definition instantiates one pattern. Authored members are the only ones a pack writes; the derived members (inputs, outputs, state, observables) may be stated for readability and are refused with CONTRACT_MISMATCH unless they equal what the pattern derives.

pattern.description: a registered pattern, pinned: truth_table@1 | merge@1

parameters.description: what the pattern's parameter schema asks for (schematic.pattern.schema.json $defs)

ports.description: presentation only: placement and label of generated ports, keyed by port id

inputs.description: derived; must equal derive(parameters).inputs when stated

outputs.description: derived; must equal derive(parameters).outputs when stated

state.description: derived; must equal derive(parameters).state when stated

observables.description: derived; must equal derive(parameters).observables when stated
